messages:
maya: Ran a long overnight sweep across A100/H100/L40S. Seq lengths 512,1024,2048,4096,8192; bsz 1/4/8/16. Notice a p99 regression on L40S when paged+fused path is selected and KV hit >~80% :thinking:
sam: ugh. waveform? tail spikes or steady drift?
maya: median fine but p99 jumps 2-3x after ~200 tokens for certain mixes. Nsight shows repeated kernel rebinds every few steps on L40S.
igor: repro command? i can run on my pod.
maya: here:
```
./bench_attn --model rwin-13b --kernels paged,fused --devices l40s --seqs 512,1024,2048,4096,8192 --bsz 1,4,8,16 --kv-warm 90 --profile nsight --runs 5
```
perf-bot: automated summary: L40S paged+fused path p99 increased from 42ms -> 130ms at seq=4096, bsz=4, kv-hit=92%. A100/H100 show <10% diff.
priya: hmm could be selector flipback between paged_fused and fused variants causing rebinds?
sam: checked recent selector change around commit abc1234 that added a "kv_density" heuristic. @igor can you bisect?
igor: starting bisect. quick local: rolling back abc1234 in canary dropped p99 back to baseline on L40S.
maya: confirmed when pinning to pre-abc1234 commit.
sam: looks like selector flip causes repeated kernel init/teardown, hurting occupancy on L40S tensor cores. Nsight shows many tiny kernel launches between main kernels.
igor: hypothesis: kv_density heuristic is too aggressive on L40S page/memory config -> it splits tiles that used to be merged into fused kernels.
priya: quick mitigation: device-specific override to ignore kv_density splits on L40S and fallback to old binding.
maya: propose PR: revert heuristic for L40S + add unit test that simulates kv hit trace >80% and asserts stable kernel binding.
sam: +1. add perf regression test: run 2k steps and assert p99 <= 1.2x baseline.
deploy-bot: scheduled canary rollout of selector-revert to 3 L40S nodes at 03:00 UTC.
igor: i'll open PR referencing abc1234 and attach nsight timelines/screenshots.
maya: leaving full logs at https://redwood.perf/reports/3589004321-kv-density-l40s (contains traces & raw bench outputs).
priya: also add a microbenchmark toggling kv-warm 95% -> 30% every 50 steps to stress evictor interplay; that caught oscillation on my local run.
sam: good call, that reproduces the kernel oscillation pattern.
maya: i'll own the PR and regression test. will post links once created :shipit:
